candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: The single order checkout trace shows 69ms OK, not reflecting payment latency; sampling may miss slow payment calls.
missing_evidence: Payment service traces showing span durations and status for checkout calls
Order-to-payment span breakdown to confirm payment dominates checkout latency
candidates.statement: Payment service p95 latency is 1600ms while gateway, order, and inventory are ~79ms with zero dependency timeouts; order depends on payment per topology, so checkout degradation is bounded to payment downstream latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Only one order trace sampled; payment latency cause (internal vs dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Payment metrics show p95 1600ms versus ~79ms elsewhere with no timeouts or pool waiters, and topology places payment under order. Gateway logs and deploy are healthy; deployment record alone cannot explain latency. One fast order trace is counter-evidence, so confidence is moderate.
